title: 200多个AI技能课程推出，学生获免费工具
titleEn: 200+ AI courses launched with free student subscriptions
summary: 新加坡推出200多个AI课程，涵盖工作生产力和业务转型。符合条件的18岁以上公民获6个月免费AI工具订阅。
summaryEn: Singapore launched over 200 AI SkillsFuture courses covering workplace productivity and business transformation. Eligible citizens age 18+ receive six-month complimentary subscriptions.
speaker: The Straits Times
